_comment: What the agent may do on its own. 'auto' = done without asking, 'draft' = prepared and shown on the dashboard for a human, 'off' = never.
_createTicketComment: createTicket = tickets suggested on the Insights tab (from the AI review and the facts). 'draft' = shown with a Create in Jira button: a person checks and edits the ticket, then confirms; 'off' = shown only as suggestions. Never 'auto'.
_documentScopeComment: Which resolved tickets documentOnDone documents. 'analyzed' = only tickets the agent analyzed. 'withFix' = also bugs it did not analyze, when a commit on main names the ticket or a branch named after it holds the fix. Older ones: node agent/document-backfill.mjs.
commentHeader: (robot) *AI analysis* — automated first analysis. Please verify before acting on it.
_supersededComment: allowSupersededTestUpdates = a change request that deliberately replaces an earlier ticket's behaviour (analysis.supersedes, e.g. DEM-33 red instead of DEM-32 blue) may update ONLY the e2e tests of those tickets; the watcher checks it, and the PR, the Jira comment and the AI review call it out. false = the fix never touches tests.
_skipKnownComment: skipKnown = the analysis' 'Already known?' kinds (analysis.priorArt.kind) that get no automatic fix: a duplicate, a fix in progress on another ticket's branch, a problem fixed on main. A regression or a problem solved before in another way is still fixed (the earlier ticket's test must keep passing).
_proposeFixWhenComment: [FE] is reproduced with a Playwright test (mocked API), [BE] with a JUnit test against the real code and H2 (agent/lib/fix.mjs). A title without a tag qualifies when every file the analysis names is under frontend/ or under backend/ (inferTagFromFiles). Remove BE from titleTags to keep backend tickets analysis-only.
_regressionGuardComment: regressionGuard = every new commit on a watched main (checked every agent.config.json guardSeconds, default 120): plain code blames the lines it changes; when they were written by the fix of a resolved bug, that bug's regression tests (KB1) run on the commit, a changed regression test in its version from before the commit. An alert (a test fails, or a fix's test was changed) is posted on the commit (GitHub) and on the tickets (Jira). It never changes the code. 'off' = no guard.
_bisectComment: bisect = after the reproduction test fails on main, plain code runs it on older commits (the earlier fix of a regression, the commit before each commit the analysis names, the last commit before the suspect window; the newest that passes is the good point) and bisects to the commit that broke it, before the fix is written. No AI; a time limit (agent.config.json bisectMinutes, default 12). The result goes to the fix and review prompts, the PR, the Jira comment, and a draft assignee (the author of that change). 'off' = no bisect.
_fixComment: proposeFix = reproduce with a browser test, fix on branch <KEY>, verify independently, open a DRAFT pull request. mergeFix is always off: a human merges.
_reviewComment: reviewFix = after a draft PR is opened, a second read-only agent reviews it and posts a COMMENT review with a risk level (it never approves or merges).
_emailComment: emailUpdates = mail a status update to MAIL_TO (per-user .env) at each milestone listed in agent.config.json mail.on (analysis ready, draft fix PR, fix stopped, AI review, documentation PR, failures). Needs SMTP_* settings; without them it is off and the watcher says why at start.
_documentComment: documentOnDone = when a ticket the agent analyzed moves to Done, write docs/knowledge on branch docs/<KEY> and open a DRAFT pull request.
_mergeDocsComment: mergeDocs = the documentation PRs on the Insights tab (Knowledge base). 'draft' = a Merge button; a person confirms each merge. 'off' = listed only. Only a docs/ branch that changes nothing but docs/knowledge/*.md can be merged from there. 'auto' is not used (decision 1 of docs/KNOWLEDGE_PLAN.md: a person merges until the knowledge lint has run for a few weeks without a miss) and behaves like 'draft'.
